# ligo_target (Resource)

A target: a resource that workloads reach through bindings, on a platform. Every change is a change request that the provider files once and waits for; it never approves one. The definition and the grants name credentials by reference, never by value.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# A database that workloads reach through bindings. Owned by this automation
# (the lock). Credentials are named by reference in the platform, never here.
resource "ligo_target" "ledger" {
  name         = "ledger-db"
  display_name = "Ledger database"
  platform     = "pg-ledger"
  jurisdiction = "dc/corp-prod/ledger"

  definition = jsonencode({
    database = "ledger"
    schema   = "ledger"
  })

  access_levels = {
    read = {
      grants = jsonencode({ roles = ["LEDGER_RO_ROLE"] })
    }
    write = {
      grants      = jsonencode({ roles = ["LEDGER_RW_ROLE"] })
      description = "Reads and writes"
    }
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `access_levels` (Attributes Map) The access levels, by name. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--access_levels))
- `definition` (String) What the platform's plugin needs to reach the target, as JSON text (jsonencode). It is checked against the platform's form when the plan can read it.
- `jurisdiction` (String) The jurisdiction of the target, among those the platform allows (its target_jurisdictions).
- `name` (String) The name; a new name is a new resource.
- `platform` (String) The platform that serves it; a target does not move to another.

### Optional

- `annotations` (Map of String) Free-form key-value text, not interpreted by ligo.
- `description` (String) What it is.
- `display_name` (String) A name for people.
- `documentation_url` (String) Where its documentation is.
- `managed` (Boolean) Whether this automation owns it (the lock): only the owner then changes it. Default: the provider's managed. false, on one that is managed, is the owner's release.
- `network_flows` (String) The network flows the target needs, as JSON text.
- `state` (String) ACTIVE (the default) or DEPRECATED (no new bindings). Removal retires it.
- `visibility` (String) Who may see it in the catalog: PUBLIC, PRIVATE or SELECTED. Default: ligo's.
- `visible_to` (List of String) With SELECTED, the jurisdiction patterns that may see it.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The name.
- `last_change_request` (String) The ID of the last change request the provider filed or waited for.
- `managed_by` (String) The SPIFFE ID of the automation that owns it; null when nobody does.
- `revision` (Number) The revision; an update names it, and ligo refuses a stale one.

<a id="nestedatt--access_levels"></a>
### Nested Schema for `access_levels`

Required:

- `grants` (String) What the level grants, as JSON text. A change may only narrow it: ligo refuses a widening.

Optional:

- `description` (String) What the level is for.
- `state` (String) ACTIVE (the default) or DEPRECATED. A level that leaves the map is retired.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# By name. The first plan after the import shows what the configuration changes.
terraform import ligo_target.ledger ledger-db
```
